description: Small team with 2-10 employees. First division of labour, but no fixed departments yet.
typical_challenges: Coordination: who does what and when?
Knowledge transfer: how do we share know-how?
Missing processes: everyone does it differently
Founder bottleneck: all decisions go through one person
Preserving culture: startup feeling vs. structure
forbidden_recommendations: Too many tools (avoid a tool zoo)
automation_priorities: Time tracking (who is working on what?)
